/.name: Homepage
figures: Covers 6 calculators for TY2027 / 2026: Salary Tax (Finance Act 2026, TY2027), Zakat (2.5% on live gold/silver nisab), Property Tax (Sections 236C & 236K), GST (18% federal goods), Fitrana 2026 (wheat Rs 300), and Ushr (10% / 5% / 7.5%).
Salary example (TY2027): Rs 150,000/month -> Rs 6,000/month tax, Rs 144,000/month take-home.

/salary-tax-calculator.name: Salary Tax
slabs: Rs 600,001 to Rs 1,200,000/year: 1% of amount exceeding Rs 600,000
Rs 1,200,001 to Rs 2,200,000/year: Rs 6,000 + 11% of amount exceeding Rs 1,200,000
Rs 2,200,001 to Rs 3,200,000/year: Rs 116,000 + 20% of amount exceeding Rs 2,200,000
Rs 3,200,001 to Rs 4,100,000/year: Rs 316,000 + 25% of amount exceeding Rs 3,200,000
Rs 4,100,001 to Rs 5,600,000/year: Rs 541,000 + 29% of amount exceeding Rs 4,100,000
Rs 5,600,001 to Rs 7,000,000/year: Rs 976,000 + 32% of amount exceeding Rs 5,600,000
Above Rs 7,000,000/year: Rs 1,424,000 + 35% of amount exceeding Rs 7,000,000
/salary-tax-calculator.surcharge: Salaried surcharge abolished in Finance Act 2026 for Tax Year 2027 (0%).
figures: TY2027 (Finance Act 2026, Section 149) has 8 slabs starting with 0% up to Rs 600,000/year (Rs 50,000/month), and salaried surcharge is abolished (0%).
Example Rs 100,000/month (Rs 1,200,000/year): tax Rs 500/month (Rs 6,000/year), take-home Rs 99,500/month.
Example Rs 150,000/month (Rs 1,800,000/year): tax Rs 6,000/month (Rs 72,000/year), take-home Rs 144,000/month.
Example Rs 200,000/month (Rs 2,400,000/year): tax Rs 13,000/month (Rs 156,000/year), take-home Rs 187,000/month.

/zakat-calculator.name: Zakat
figures: Zakat rate: 2.5% on net zakatable wealth held for one full lunar year (Hawl).
Gold Nisab: 7.5 tola = 87.48 grams; Silver Nisab: 52.5 tola = 612.36 grams.
Never hard-code rupee gold or silver prices; compute dynamically using live variables goldPerTola (7.5 * goldPerTola) and silverPerTola (52.5 * silverPerTola).
Example Rs 500,000 net zakatable cash (when above Nisab): Zakat Rs 12,500.
Example Rs 777,777 net zakatable cash (when above Nisab): exact Zakat Rs 19,444.43 (UI rounded headline Rs 19,444).

/property-tax-calculator.name: Property Tax
figures: Section 236C (Seller advance tax, TY2027): Filer 2.75%, Non-Filer 11.5% (late-filer tier removed in TY2027).
Section 236K (Buyer advance tax, TY2027): Filer 1.25% flat; Non-Filer tiered 10.5% (<= Rs 50M), 14.5% (Rs 50M–100M), 18.5% (> Rs 100M).
Example Rs 10,000,000 property purchase by a Filer (Section 236K @ 1.25%): buyer advance tax Rs 125,000.

/gst-calculator.name: GST
figures: Federal Standard GST on Goods (Sales Tax Act 1990): 18% federal rate (provincial services vary by PRA/SRB/KPRA/BRA).
Example Add 18% GST on Rs 100,000: GST Rs 18,000, Total Rs 118,000.
Example Remove 18% GST from Rs 100,000 inclusive: Base Rs 84,745.76, GST Rs 15,254.24.

/fitrana-calculator.name: Fitrana
figures: Official Fitrana 2026 per-person rates (Mufti Muneeb-ur-Rehman, 21 Feb 2026): Wheat Rs 300, Barley Rs 1,160, Dates Rs 2,800, Raisins Rs 7,200.
Example family of 5 (Wheat @ Rs 300/person): Rs 1,500 total.

/ushr-calculator.name: Ushr
figures: Ushr rates: Rain/River natural irrigation 10%, Tube-well/artificial irrigation 5%, Mixed equal irrigation 7.5%.
1 maund = 40 kg (costs of seed/fertilizer/harvesting are not deducted; do NOT state Ordinance exemption threshold due to scholarly conflict).
Example 2,000 kg tube-well crop (5%): Ushr 100 kg.
Example 100 maund = 4,000 kg crop: 400 kg (rain 10%), 200 kg (tube-well 5%), or 300 kg (mixed equal 7.5%).
